title: Abbas Ammu Janam
body:
Abbas(as) Ammujanam, Abbas Ammujana,
Boli Sakina(sa) rokar, Abbas Ammujanam..
1) Maare gaye Akbar(as) bhi, maare gaye Asghar(as) bhi,
Dasht-e-balaa me jaakar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
2) Tanha pada hai laasha ab mere Babaja'an ka,
Tapti hui zamee'n par, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
3) Pyaase hain saare bacche, behlaaun unko kaise,
Paani pilaado aakar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
4) Shaam-e-Ghariba'an aayi, deti hu mai duhaayi,
Chhinti hai sar se chadar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
5) Shimr-e-laeen ne haaye, khenche hain kis tarah se,
Kaanou se mere gouhar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
6) Zalim sataa rahe hain, durre lagaa rahe hain,
Hota hai zulm mujh par, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
7) Ab Dar se aake dekho, qaidi banaake humko,
Lejaate hain sitamgar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
8) Jis raah se bhi guzri, pyaasi teri Bhatiji,
Khaati rahi vo pathhar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
9) Kis tarha mai bataaun, kis tarha mai bhulaaun,
Darbar ka wo manzar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
10) Toote pahaad gham ke, ab qaid se sitam ke,
Chudwaao jald aakar, Abbas(as) Ammujanam..
11) Hasnain aur Sahil ab kya bayaan karenge(sa),
Rote rahe ye sun kar, Abbas (as) Ammujanam..
